landing.heroTitle: Inventory, sales & stock — one platform for shops, stores, hotels and restaurants.
landing.heroSub: Kass Inv. is a bilingual (English & Amharic) platform that runs your whole operation: products, stock across locations, purchases and approvals, sales at the till, credit and cash, hospitality orders, finance and reports — live and in real time.
landing.mInventoryD: Live stock counts per product, batch and location with low-stock alerts.
landing.mSalesD: Fast POS-style selling with discounts, payments and printed receipts.
landing.mProductsD: Brands, units, variants, batches, SKUs, barcodes and price history.
landing.mLocationsD: Shops and stores, target stock and transfers between them.
landing.mRestockD: Buy stock, quick purchases and supplier-side stock requests.
landing.mRequestsD: Shopkeepers request, owners approve, dispatchers send, receivers confirm — every step tracked.
landing.mCustomersD: Customer accounts, credit sales, payments and outstanding debts.
landing.mHospitalityD: Menus, tables, station boards (kitchen/bar/barista), room service and guest folios.
landing.mFinanceD: Chart of accounts, expenses, journal entries and profit visibility.
landing.mTaxesD: VAT rates, tax-inclusive pricing and fiscal-ready receipts.
landing.mReportsD: Sales, inventory, hospitality and activity reports with CSV/PDF export.
landing.mUsersD: Owners, managers, cashiers and waiters — with precise permissions per business.
landing.retailStep1: Create your business, then add shops and stores.
landing.retailStep2: Add products with units, prices and barcodes.
landing.retailStep3: Buy and receive stock from suppliers.
landing.retailStep4: Shopkeepers request stock; the owner approves and dispatches.
landing.retailStep5: Receive on arrival, sell at the till, track credits.
landing.retailStep6: Watch live stock, profit and reports — in English or Amharic.
landing.hospStep1: Set up menus, tables and stations (kitchen, bar, barista).
landing.hospStep2: Take orders for tables or take-away.
landing.hospStep3: Kitchen and bar update items until ready.
landing.hospStep4: Waiters serve; guests settle and receipts print.
landing.hospStep5: Live station boards and dashboards keep the whole team in sync.
landing.whoRetailD: Single shops and multi-branch businesses that need simple, reliable stock and sales.
landing.whoDistD: Store-to-store transfers, bulk purchases and team approvals across locations.
landing.whoHospD: Tables, kitchens, bars and room service running on one shared ledger.
landing.bRealtime: Real-time stock across every location — no more spreadsheets.
landing.bAccountable: Clear approvals, dispatches and staff roles — every action is recorded.
landing.bMoney: Cash, float, credit and customer debts under control.
landing.bBilingual: A bilingual (English & Amharic) workspace for your whole team.
landing.bFiscal: Fiscal-ready receipts, VAT and tax reporting.
landing.bReports: Reports you can export and act on — sales, stock and activity.
landing.ctaTitle: Start managing with Kass Inv. today.
landing.ctaSub: Create your first business in minutes — invite your team, add stock and make your first sale.
